spec_case: issue #503 (transport, a config-default adapter whose host refuses the connection)
description: A config-default lmstudio pointed at a closed port, retries: {max_attempts: 2, backoff_ms: 1}, on_error: continue: curl exit 7 (connection refused) is retryable, so both attempts run and retries_used is 1; curl's own stderr clause there is matched by pattern (third_party_text), not byte-for-byte.

third_party_text.pattern: All adapter attempts failed: \[\{'adapter': 'lmstudio', 'model': 'm', 'status': 'failed', 'error': \"OpenAI-compatible request failed \(curl exit 7\) model='m' url=http://127\.0\.0\.1:1/chat/completions: .*?\", 'tokens_sent': None, 'tokens_received': None\}\]
